# telnyx_ai_mcp_servers (Data Source)

Lists ai mcp servers, with optional filters. Each item has the attributes of `telnyx_ai_mcp_server`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "telnyx_ai_mcp_servers" "all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `max_items` (Number) Stop reading after this many items. By default every page is read.
- `type` (String)
- `url` (String)

### Read-Only

- `ai_mcp_servers` (Attributes List) The objects, in the order the API returns them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ai_mcp_servers))
